status_note: Day complete — veg-forward breakfast, light canapé snacks, strong chicken lunch, then a big shared-plates dinner at claro; London (frena bread, venison tartare, yellowtail sashimi, veg salad, salsify, lamb platter, smoked trout, a taste of gnocchi, 2 small glasses of red wine) capped off with a bite of all 3 menu desserts + a pistachio puff pastry + 4 strawberries, creatine at 22:07.
